author: GameTrailers
description: From Kepler and Frictional Games comes Ontos, a sci-fi mystery set in a horrifying hotel on the moon, this immersive narrative with systems-driven gameplay pushes you to question reality. Wishlist now on Xbox Series X/S, PS5, and Steam.
title: Ontos - Wishlist Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Cinder City gameplay was featured in this latest trailer, and it was shown off with NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 and Ray Tracing. In the footage, you'll learn more of the open world of near-future Seoul and "intense combat" that awaits in this cinematic third-person shooter.
title: Cinder City - Gameplay Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Project Zeta is a new hero shooter from Krafton. Kallipolis has called on you to stop the Dimensional Storms. Rise up as a wide array of heroes in this PVP multiplayer game you can wishlist now on Steam.
title: Project Zeta - Wishlist Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: 1999's Heroes of Might and Magic III getting a full remake on PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and PC, inviting players to return to Erathia and experience the beloved turn-based strategy classic and its two expansions once more, just this time in full 3D and 4K.
title: Heroes of Might and Magic 3 Remake - Official Reveal Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: From Level Infinite, bEhaviour, and Shooter & Creative Team comes Exterminauts, a game where you'll travel space to do the dirty work that needs to be done on the edge of space. Punch in, clean up, get paid. Wishlist now on PS5, Xbox Series X/S, Steam, and Epic.
title: Exterminauts - Wishlist Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Path of Exile 2 is set to enter Version 1.0 on December 11, 2026, and fans got a new look at the title to celebrate the news. 

Path of Exile 2 entered Early Access in 2024 and players will soon get to jump into the official release.
title: Path of Exile 2 - Official Version 1.0 Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: LEGO Skylines is a charming new city-builder coming to Steam, Switch 2, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S. Wishlist now.
title: LEGO Skylines - Official Announcement Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
1666: Amsterdam has officially entered Early Access and Panache Digital Games shared a brand-new gameplay trailer to get players excited.

Every 333 years, something stirs, and players will discover exactly what that is in this third-person dark, story-led, action-adventure game. 

Players will become Noa, the Collector, who wields witchcraft to uncover demonic entities hiding behind human faces. Investigate during the day, and face your demons when the sun goes down.
title: 1666 Amsterdam - Official Launch Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Mankind's best friend takes to the stars in a new 3rd person action game by Octopus Panic. Loyal, obedient, and tireless, the Gravhounds have traveled the galaxy to mine, gather resources, and find a way home. Gravhounds comes to Early access in 2026.
title: Gravhounds - Official Reveal Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Turok: Origins is headed to PS5, Xbox Series X/S, Switch 2, and PC in Spring 2027, and will let players battle dinosaurs, aliens, and more alone of with friends. To do so, players will get to take utilize an arsenal of futuristic weapons, harness Turok powers, and explore the Lost Lands.
title: Turok: Origins - Official Story Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Crazy Taxi is coming back with more fares, more unhinged requests, and more bad driving driving than you can shake a stick at.
Crazy Taxi: World Tour comes to your town on Xbox, PS5, Switch 2, and Steam in 2027. Sign up for the closed network test now.
title: Crazy Taxi: World Tour - Official Multiplayer Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Stage Tour will officially be released on on December 10, 2026. In this music game, there are over 90 licensed songs, 180+ authentic in-game Gibson Guitars, 50+ bandmates, official hardware, new ways to play, and much more. Get ready to rock out to Metallica, The Rolling Stones, Red Hot Chili Peppers, Olivia Rodrigo, blink-182, Paramore, Slipknot, Muse, and more.
title: Stage Tour - Official Release Date Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a look at Crimson Desert Enhanced, a new version of the open-world action-adventure game that features new story moments, expanded voice-over, and language support. 

Crimson Desert Enhanced is free update for all owners of the base game that is available now.
title: Crimson Desert Enhanced - Official Announcement Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Sea of Remnants is a new RPG where you become the Captain, calling the shots and leading your crew to adventure and fortune on the high seas. Sea of Remnants comes to PC via Steam and Epic, PlayStation and Xbox.
title: Sea of Remnants - Winds of Memory Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Ahead of its September 24, 2026, release date, Konami has revealed a new gameplay video that dives deep into Silent Hill: Townfall's cast, including Jovan Adepo (3 Body Problem, IT: Welcome to Derry, The Odyssey) as Simon, Kezia Burrows (Observation) as Zoe, and Terry O'Quinn (Lost, The Walking Dead: The Ones Who Live) as Richard.
title: Silent Hill: Townfall - Official Cast Reveal Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Set during the tragic, apocalyptic Emergence Day when the Locust Horde rose up to destroy humanity, Gears of War E-Day is coming on October 6, 2026 as an Xbox console exclusive.
title: Gears Of War E-Day - Official Story Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Ubisoft has just announced Rainbow Six Tactics, a new single-player turn-based tactics game that will feature Rainbow Six Siege Operators fans have come to know and love. 

This will be the first single-player game in the franchise since Rainbow Six Vegas 2 in 2008. Players will step into the shoes of Vegas' Paul ""Six"" Bishop, who will be commanding the Operators from a remote location.

Rainbow Six Tactics will be released on PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and PC in 2027.
title: Rainbow Six Tactics - Official Reveal Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Ananta gets a new trailer showcasing gameplay and more of its vibrant world, along with a release date. Check out the Ananta release date trailer for this upcoming urban open-world RPG where you play as a variety of characters. Ananta will be available on Windows PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), the App Store, and Google Play on January 15, 2027.
title: Ananta - Official Release Date Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Nodus Fall is a brand new game from Hoyoverse. Set in a world beset by chaos and haunted by ancient hatreds, Nodus Fall is an original co-op action game where players take on the role of a Weaver and use divine power to conquer mythical beasts.
title: Nodus Fall - World Premiere Reveal Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Reveal Trailer for Age Twisters, a co-op narrative adventure game developed by Piccolo Studio. Players will solve puzzles and seek the truth of a web of lies in a co-op adventure with a grandfather and granddaughter. Age Twisters is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Age Twisters - Official Reveal Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Petit Planet is a new game from miHoYo where players will customize their characters, and live, fish, visit, and get to know others in an adorable world, building their homes and expanding their small worlds to their liking in this cozy cosmic life sim.
title: Petit Planet - Official Pre-Register Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Humankind 2 announcement trailer for this upcoming historical turn-based strategy game. Build a civilization that spans the ages in Humankind 2. Combine evolving cultures, raise cities, command armies and expand your empire as a changing climate reshapes the world and your path through history. Humankind 2 will be available on PC in 2027.
title: Humankind 2 - Official Announcement Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Snoop Dogg will officially be the next elusive target in Hitman World of Assassination, as players will need to serve Dr. Cyrus Cane a "taste of his own medicine."

The Herbalist mission will be free for all players from August 27 through September 26, 2026.
title: Hitman World of Assassination - Official Snoop Dogg Elusive Target Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Silver Palace is an action RPG by Silver Studio, set in a Victorian-themed metropolis where you'll face off against mysterious spectral figures as you solve mysteries as a detective. Silver Palace comes to PC, mobile platforms, and PlayStation.
title: Silver Palace - House of Greed Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
4A Games revealed the second gameplay trailer for Metro 2039, which gives a new glimpse at the game's protagonist, The Stranger. Get more familiar with the game's mechanics, weaponry, and combat both below and above ground.

Metro 2039 will be released in February 2027.
title: Metro 2039 - Official 'Renegade' Gameplay Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Aion 2 is headed to PC on October 5, 2026, and gamescom's Opening Night Live shared with us a new look at the next-gen MMORPG built in Unreal Engine 5.

Aion 2 welcomes thousands of players to a world waiting to be explored across land, sea, and air, extensive character customization, collectible pets, robust PvP and PvE experiences, and much more.
title: Aion 2 - Official Gameplay Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: 1001 Threads of Mizan is a 1-3 person co-op action adventure set in a world of Arabian fantasy. Inspired by the classical tale of One Thousand and One Nights (AKA Arabian Nights) told by Scheherazade. 1001 Threads of Mizan comes to Steam, Epic, Switch 2, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S.
title: 1001 Threads of Mizan - Official Demo Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Opening Night Live gave us an extended look at gameplay for Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons, a third-person, single-player action-adventure set in a dark fantasy open world inspired by D&D.

Players will become Kaatri, a warrior who makes a dangerous pact with Tasha to find someone she has lost. She'll need to combine forbidden magic, spells, rituals, and otherworldly weapons to ""open paths, create advantages, uncover secrets, and defeat monsters creatively."" Oh, and you'll need to venture beyond the Mists of Darkon to do so.

Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons will be released on PS5, Xbox Series X, and PC in 2027.
title: Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons - Official Gameplay Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Zodiac Resurgence Map Trailer for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, the latest installment in the first-person shooter franchise developed by Infinity Ward. Warzone players can dive into the new Resurgence map called Zodiac, packed with new points of interest and places to explore in Weekend 2 of the beta for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. Fight on the Zodiac Resurgence Map from August 28 through September 1 during the Weekend 2 beta for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, launching on October 23 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (BattleNet, Steam, Xbox on PC).
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - Official Zodiac Resurgence Map Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Gameplay Trailer for The End of Allegoria, a tactical turn-based RPG developed by Button Factory Games. Players will explore a thriving world with companions to learn skills, master equipment, and guide the fate of the planet one decision at a time. The End of Allegoria is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: The End of Allegoria - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Release Date Trailer for Well Dweller, a dark fantasy Metroidvania action-adventure game developed by Kyle Thompson. Players will embody a small yet mighty bird on a larger-than-life adventure to burn the queen to the ground to save his family. Harness new abilities, discover long-hidden secrets, and overcome platforming challenges along the way. Well Dweller is launching on September 22 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and GoG).
title: Well Dweller - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a sneak peek at gameplay from My Time at Evershine, an upcoming wholesome 3D open-world simulation in which you'll lead (and romance!) the people of the Evershine Settlement. It's the third game in the My Time series, set three years after the events of My Time at Sandrock and My Time at Portia. It's due out in 2027 for PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3199500/My_Time_at_Evershine/
title: My Time at Evershine - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Bonsai Island, a wholesome bonsai shop and life simulation game developed by Hyphenation Studio. Players will grow and shape beautiful trees to sell at their local shop. Seek out new species and live a life of leisure in Bonsai Island, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Bonsai Island - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Season 1 Trailer for NBA 2K27, the latest entry in the basketball simulation franchise developed by Visual Concepts. Players can get the rundown on what's in store with the arrival of Season 1, including new rewards, content, and more. Season 1 for NBA 2K27 is launching on August 26 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: NBA 2K27 - Official Season 1 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a deep dive into the gameplay and presentation of NHL 27 in this latest trailer for the upcoming sports game. The new video details what you can expect from these features, including team-specific playbooks, a new broadcast package, authentic arenas, and signature goal songs. NHL 27 will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S on September 11, with Early Access for Deluxe Edition owners kicking off on September 4.
title: NHL 27 - Official Gameplay and Presentation Deep Dive Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Launch Trailer for Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2, a third-person survival horror shooter developed by Cold Iron Studios. Players will head straight into the fray to take on the lethal Xenomorphs from corridor to corridor. Leverage class-specific abilities, build effective loadouts, and survive at all costs. Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Vision: Vaan Trailer for Final Fantasy Resonance, an upcoming HD-2D turn-based RPG developed by Square Enix. Players can make use of the might and power of Vaan, first seen in Final Fantasy 12. Call upon Vaan's firey power in Final Fantasy Resonance, launching on October 22 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Final Fantasy Resonance - Official Vision: Vaan Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a peek at customization options and how you can create your own Warrior Cat in this latest Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest teaser trailer for the upcoming turn-based RPG inspired by the Warrior Cats novel series. In Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest, customize your cat with unique fur patterns, colors, tails, whiskers, ears, eyes, markings, and more. With deep customization options inspired by the Warrior Cats universe, you can create a warrior that feels truly your own and bring your character to life. Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest will be available on PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2 in fall 2026.

In Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest, hunt prey, hone your skills, and defend your home against rival warriors as you rise through the ranks of your Clan. Experience previously untold stories of the Warrior Cats world and build a legacy that will last a lifetime. Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
title: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - Official 'Build Your Warrior Cat' Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Launch Trailer for Twisted Party, a retro horror party game developed by Vampire Squid. Players will face deadly challenges with friends in pursuit of being the last player standing when it's all said and done. Survive lethal mini-games, unlock new skins, and do what it takes to attain victory. Twisted Party is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Twisted Party - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Devil's Liminal will leave Early Access and the full release will be available on PC on September 1, 2026. Watch the Devil's Liminal trailer for this yuri horror visual novel inspired by Azores folklore and Goethe’s Faust, featuring a story about overcoming poverty and violence wrapped in a fantastical tale of alchemists and demons spanning 500 years.

Margo Silva has done everything she can to leave behind the trailer park in Arizona where she grew up. Now all she has to do is focus on her summer job until she can leave for college, but her illusion of a quiet summer is shattered when a hungry ghost enters her dreams. To make matters worse, Margo must also contend with a demon’s claim on her soul. Two mysterious girls show up in town, each claiming they can help her, but each harboring her own motives and secrets. Now she must choose between two blossoming romances while trying to piece herself back together. As the ghost grows in power, will she be able to save her soul before Septe
title: Devil's Liminal - Official Full Release Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Meet Robin . Summeretto in this latest Honkai: Star Rail trailer for the space fantasy RPG. Honkai: Star Rail is available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), iOS, Android, and PC (HoYoPlay and Epic Games Store).
title: Honkai: Star Rail - Official Robin . Summeretto Character Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Release Date Trailer for Penguin Colony, a retro Lovecraftian walking simulator developed by Origame Digital. Players will bear witness to humans invading their precious home in Antarctica as a simple penguin. See the humans' descent into complete madness and disarray in Penguin Colony, launching on October 8 for PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Penguin Colony - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss this latest entry in the Curious Cases video series for Onimusha Way of The Sword. This time focusing on Shuten Doji, a Genma warrior who has claimed the fortress at the peak of Mount Oe. Much darkness surrounds Oe and Shuten Doji, uncover the secrets of Mount Oe when Onimusha Way of The Sword launches on September 4th for PC (Steam), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2 and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Onimusha Way of The Sword - Official Shuten Doji Trailer
